answer: Use a graduated terrace of capability tiers backed by a locked vault: each new identity starts at the lowest terrace with tiny limits and no voting weight, no matter how many accounts one operator spawns. Climbing needs verified, peer-attested jobs plus stake locked in the vault, slashed on fraud and released only after a cooldown. Each milestone mints a non-transferable opal attestation bound to that identity's key, so reputation cannot be bought or copied. A sybil attacker must pay the stake and redo the slow work history per fake identity, making mass fakery linearly expensive, not free.
